name: Tsubaki Risa
source:
Risa is a second grader in Kirigaoka Gakuin Middle School, she has a logical, quiet and mature personality. Principal Chitose is worried about her because Risa has no friends and avoids getting involved with other students. She is suspicious of the angel Hinamizu, and mysterious person Arata.

[Translated from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monochrome_(%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
